description: Phase W4 runtime snapshot shape for world/data/runtime/portfolio.json. Presentation-only reflection of portfolio state - not the source of truth (that remains the trading engine's own portfolio/ module, which this schema never reads from or writes to). Phase W11 amendment (see docs/architecture/SEPARATION_POLICY.md): the optional top-level `summary` object is a deliberate, explicit exception allowing real read-only portfolio-wide figures (PnL/drawdown/win rate) to cross the boundary - individual positions still never carry raw notional size (see `sizeLabel` below).

district.description: Always portfolio-garden in the current district map.

sizeLabel.description: Free-text display label, e.g. 'small'/'medium'/'large' - deliberately not a raw notional amount, to keep this a presentation-only reflection.

summary.description: Phase W11 - optional, portfolio-wide, read-only figures sourced verbatim from the trading engine's own existing accessors (portfolio.portfolio_history.get_latest_decisions(), journal.journal_v2.get_daily_stats()). Never computed in world/. Every field is independently optional; a key is omitted rather than set to a fabricated 0 when the engine didn't supply it this capture.
